key_provisions_or_claims: Sets principles for AI development and use: human dignity, risk-based safety, non-discrimination, privacy, copyright, education.
Defines high-risk AI uses: biometric identification, critical infrastructure, education, employment, social programs, credit, justice, health, law enforcement.
Imposes specific obligations on entities using high-risk AI, including risk identification and assessment.
Applies to public entities, FONAFE state enterprises and private/civil society users in the digital transformation system.
Makes NTP-ISO/IEC 27002 mandatory for public administration information security.
annotation.summary_en: Peru's regulation implementing Law 31814 on promoting AI for economic and social development. It sets guiding principles, a risk-based approach with a high-risk list (biometrics, employment, credit, health, justice, law enforcement), obligations for high-risk uses, and mandatory ISO/IEC 27002 security controls in public administration.
annotation.title_clean: Reglamento de la Ley N° 31814, Ley que promueve el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en favor del desarrollo económico y social del país
annotation.title_en: Regulation of Law No. 31814, Law Promoting the Use of Artificial Intelligence for the Country's Economic and Social Development
